The complete 31-line triple-intersection enumeration proves the only nonendpoint combinatorial transition on [0,1/4] is 1/6; vertices are affine, hence each area and the sum are quadratic on the two cells. Exact rational clipping at three nodes in each cell determines both polynomials; seven further exact tests corroborate. Parameter symmetries, Walsh inversion and a quadratic zero analysis yield the exact four-word distribution and iff clause. A polynomial Bowen covering argument shows entropy zero. The saved package includes a standalone rational certificate; no inference from finite floating-point experiments or truncated enumeration is needed.

value.rationale: The first nontrivial joint information statistic beyond known pairwise/3-wise independence is the consecutive four-sign Walsh coefficient. Its exact phase law identifies a sharp breakpoint, the complete set of irrational parameters at which all 16 four-word cylinders have their Bernoulli probabilities, and a closed Shannon-entropy deficit despite zero metric entropy. These are intrinsic invariants of a canonical Anzai skew product, relevant for interpreting finite-block tests for randomness in zero-entropy dynamics, not an arbitrary parameter slice or known table recomputation. The result does not promise general four-time independence.
